definitions.gloss: cherry blossom pink; pale pink; blush pink
definitions.explanation: A soft, pale pink color reminiscent of cherry blossoms. One of the traditional Japanese color names, widely associated with spring.

examples.japanese: {桜色|さくらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スカーフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{桜色|さくらいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: The sky was dyed cherry blossom pink by the sunset.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{桜色|さくらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧や⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{店頭|てんとう}→店頭：12488_tentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, cherry-blossom-pink sweets and drinks line the store shelves.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{桜色|さくらいろ} is one of Japan's traditional color names ({伝統色|でんとうしょく}). It is strongly associated with spring and is widely used in seasonal marketing — many spring-limited products feature this color.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桜色|さくらいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧ (to be dyed cherry blossom pink)
- {桜色|さくらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧ (rosy/blushing cheeks)
- {桜色|さくらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧ (a pink kimono)

RELATED COLORS:
- {薄桃色|うすももいろ} (light peach) — similar but slightly warmer
- ⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧ — the general loanword for pink
